4. **Reassurance amid damage control**: Even while acknowledging the crisis, the note tries to reassure employees and investors that Enron's current position and core businesses remain intact. [2001-11-08, From: chairman.ken@enron.com, Subject: SEC Information/Earnings Restatement]
